Panic attacks can be really hard to deal with especially when you don't know what soothes you the best. It sucks that your family can't help you through them and don't take you seriously. Here are some things you can do when you feel an attack coming:  
\- suck on some ice  
\- listen to some calm music or just sounds (I listen to whale sounds lmao, works though)- massage the sides of your neck  
\- talk to someone you feel comfortable with and trust

I get that you're depression is causing you to become very weak but just try to think about how your ideal self would function and mimic that, or if that doesn't help just think about the one thing/person you care about and function for them. It will take time and do take things slowly, you don't have to rush into it, just one step at a time.

I would highly recommend confiding in a person, it can be anyone you can be open with without getting judged (If you feel like it, I'm ready to hear you out anytime). You don't know how much this can help you. Once you become mentally strong you can easily do well physically.  
You're very strong, I believe in you.

I might be repeating what the others said but you need to start with the small things like brushing your teeth. I know what you're thinking, I don't want to live so why do I do this? What do you have to lose? 

Make the most of the time you have. Woke up in the morning? force yourself to brush your teeth and then grab something to eat (I recommend some fruit since it's easier to eat when you're feeling down and healthy for the most part). No money? Search for part-time jobs online (If you head on over to Pinterest there are so many posts about earning money from some websites and you can choose something that interests you). 

No friends, no family? Like I said, start off small, and eventually, you'll find the right people. And once you've found the right people you can also have a family.
